description: Elections Commission - M. G. D Chandrasiri of the Seethawaka Pradeshiya sabha has Vacated his office of Members of the United National Party, S. S. K Rupasinghe of the Seethawaka Pradeshiya sabha has Vacated his office of Members of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that a member of a Pradeshiya Sabha (local government body) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which includes matters related to electoral boundaries, candidate registrations, and the status of elected officials.
